text:
Sam H: Heads-up — planning SDK v5 rollout next Tue 10:00 PT. Major goals: preserve backwards compatibility, run a canary (5%), smoke tests, and have rollback ready. Who can own canary watch and client comms? :eyes:

Jaya P: I can own client comms / migration guide. Will update quickstart, changelog, and add a migration snippet for the new response shape. ETA EOD Fri. :+1:

Mike L: I can own the canary monitoring and smoke checks. Note: runtime has a small change to embedding payload (field name renamed). It's backward-compatible if clients send old key, but we should still validate both. I recommend a 30m maintenance buffer after rollout start.

Sam H: Thanks. Can you paste the smoke test steps here so Oncall can run them and we can automate? Also we should confirm the route toggle for rollback is tested.

Mike L: Smoke script (run from infra host):
```bash
# basic generation smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v5/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello world","max_tokens":5}' 

# embeddings check
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v5/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"testing"}'
```
Run these against the canary endpoint (x-canary: true header) and assert status 200 and token usage not wildly different.

ops-runner: Can you schedule the canary job to start at rollout +5m and run every 2m for first 30m? Also ensure alerting on error-rate > 1% for that slice.

ops-runner: scheduled the job: https://ci.redwood/schedules/sku-canary-1782 — will run at +5m every 2m for 30m. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

DevEx Bot: FYI — toggles for SDK routing exist. To rollback you can flip header mapping in the control plane: `x-client-sdk-version: v4`. We should verify this in staging today.

Jaya P: I'll push the migration doc draft to the repo and ping here when ready. Also, should we send an email to top 10 paying customers about a non-breaking opt-in change?

Sam H: Yes, DevRel/Account Execs should get a short note. Jaya, can you prepare a 1-paragraph blurb we can copy into outreach?

Jaya P: Yep. Draft ready by Mon morning.

Mike L: One more check: if we see an unexpected perf regression, plan is: 1) pause canary, 2) flip primary route to v4, 3) roll back runtime image. I tested route flip in staging and it reverted within ~40s.

Sam H: Perfect. Owners: canary/watch = Mike, client comms = Jaya, ops scheduling = ops-runner. I'll do the admin rollout (start toggle + monitor for first 10m). Please ack if that's accurate. :thumbsup:

Mike L: Ack.

Jaya P: Ack.

ops-runner: Ack.

Sam H: Great — last item: can everyone run the staged toggle test in staging today? Post results here when done.

Mike L: Running it now, will post logs in 10m.

DevEx Bot: CI canary job queued: https://ci.redwood/job/sku-canary/452 — will attach results when complete.
